title: Viewer
author: claude
summary: The web page that shows the baked room with the table and chairs, and how the table is lit and reflected.
what: The lab page itself, how the table is lit, and a key finding about brightness and reflections.
why: We need to see the baked room and the live-lit table together in a browser, and tune them by eye.
how: Three steps: write the viewer, find out why per-part brightness did nothing, and make reflections line up with the room.

tech.name: three.js
tech.plain: Draws 3D scenes in the web browser.

tech.name: React Three Fiber
tech.plain: Lets us describe a three.js scene with React building blocks.
